aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food trucks and mobile catering: online orders, collection times and fewer repetitive questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: Who we are — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile catering, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time dealing with repetitive questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet much of the software available to them is designed around businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses actually operate.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory helping people discover food trucks visiting their local area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly moving, working at different locations and serving customers in changing conditions.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers place a pre-order for a future date or time, before the event.
featuresPage.detail.advanced_reporting: Break down sales by dates, dish and event to see what really sells.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm them one by one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Assign a buzzer number to the order when you hand it out, so you know which buzzer belongs to each order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen visible to customers with the order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map so nearby customers find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one links directly to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen (KDS), and the only way to keep taking orders when you lose coverage.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Say how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a slot fills up, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward repeat customers with digital stamp cards — the stamps add up and are redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Group dishes into meal deals and offer extras at checkout to raise the average ticket.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Like the WhatsApp auto-replies, for Messenger and Instagram enquiries.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — counter and kitchen — with the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give your team their own login with the right level of permissions.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose coverage, online orders pause so nobody places orders you won’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you keep taking orders offline; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment in advance when customers order online, through Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a cut-off time for dishes that need advance preparation.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that do not appear on the map, with their own link and QR code for ordering.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and your ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You just review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Notify customers by SMS automatically when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add your dates, places and times for each week and each event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any dish as sold out with one tap — it appears grey for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Enter the stock and it is deducted with each order; when it reaches zero, the dish sells out by itself.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments from a compatible mobile, without needing a separate card reader.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print the kitchen tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose their collection time within a time slot, so demand is spread across the service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the counter window, charged on your own card reader.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser of any mobile, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: WhatsApp auto-replies to enquiries about your menu and your schedule.
